compatibility.v1Contract: PV-ENHANCE-I2I-001 remains byte-compatible and retains target=hair-color
compatibility.operationEnvelope: schema v2 uses the existing operation=i2i envelope and durable queue
compatibility.malformedOrFuture: reader-only unsupported row; never coerce, execute, retry, reorder, open, or delete as a managed image enhancement

sourceSelectionV2.absent: use sourceId as the indexed Original source
sourceSelectionV2.present: resolve exactly one succeeded photoreal job for the same indexed Original; the client never supplies its managed output path
sourceSelectionV2.persistedIdentity: sourceId, sourcePath, and sourceSignature remain the Original catalog identity; sourceProducerJobId records the optional photoreal input provenance
sourceSelectionV2.retry: preserve sourceProducerJobId and revalidate the producer immediately before execution

seed.missing: choose once at enqueue and persist the resolved integer

requestV2.normalization: trim each string without rewriting its wording
requestV2.legacyTarget: target=hair-color is handled only by enhancement-i2i-v1

promptPolicyV1.trackedExample: config/i2i-prompts.example.json contains deliberately invalid dummy placeholders only
promptPolicyV1.requiredSubstitution: each private target template contains {{instruction}}; {{details}} is optional
promptPolicyV1.missingOrInvalid: v2 writer not ready; v1 hair writer and all readers remain unaffected
promptPolicyV1.snapshot: persist only the derived prompt, policy revision, raw-file SHA-256, and prompt UTF-8 SHA-256 needed for durable retry
promptPolicyV1.healthDisclosure: report revision and hashes only; never return template text

snapshotV2.promptSnapshotSha256: lowercase SHA-256 of the exact prompt UTF-8 bytes
snapshotV2.unknownFields: preserve when a compatible writer rewrites the row
snapshotV2.retry: reuse the complete persisted preset, prompt, policy receipts, seed, and source provenance without loading the current prompt policy

executionV2.failClosed: no output is published when the target-specific invariant or exact selected source cannot be established

capabilityV2.additiveTo: capabilities.i2i remains the v1 hair-color capability
capabilityV2.enqueueGate: POST operation=i2i schema v2 requires readerReady, writerEnabled, backendConfigured, promptPolicyConfigured, and ready to all be exactly true and target to be listed in supportedTargets
capabilityV2.notReady: validate request and source envelope, then return 503 I2I_BACKEND_NOT_READY without writing a job or waking the queue
capabilityV2.passiveRead: health and Jobs readers never load models or start the worker
